meta.name: The Three Gunas
meta.outline: Verses 1–4: the highest knowledge, with nature as the womb and Krishna as the father of all beings; 5–9: the three gunas, goodness, passion and dullness, and how each one binds; 10–13: how to tell which guna is strongest; 14–18: where each guna leads, at death and after; 19–20: going beyond the gunas; 21–27: the signs of a person who has gone beyond them, and devotion as the way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः
words: I shall tell you again the highest
have gone from here to the highest perfection
verses.tr: Krishna said: I shall tell you once more the highest knowledge, the best of all knowledge. Knowing it, all the sages have gone from this world to the highest perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च
words: they have come to share my nature
they are not born even at creation
and are not troubled at the dissolution
verses.tr: Those who take refuge in this knowledge come to share my nature. They are not born when the world is created, and they are not troubled when it dissolves.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: in it I place the seed
verses.tr: Great nature is my womb. In it I place the seed, and from that, Arjuna, all beings are born.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and I am the father who gives the seed
verses.tr: Whatever forms are born in any womb, Arjuna, great nature is their womb and I am the father who gives the seed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the unchanging soul to the body
verses.tr: Goodness, passion and dullness, the three gunas born of nature, bind the unchanging soul to the body, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: it binds by attachment to happiness
verses.tr: Of these, goodness is pure, and so it gives light and health. It binds by attachment to happiness and to knowledge, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: know that passion is of the nature of desire
it gives rise to craving and attachment
verses.tr: Know that passion is of the nature of desire, and gives rise to craving and attachment. It binds the soul, Arjuna, by attachment to action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: but know that dullness is born of ignorance
verses.tr: But know that dullness is born of ignorance and deludes all beings. It binds, Arjuna, by carelessness, laziness and sleep.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत
words: goodness ties a person to happiness
verses.tr: Goodness ties a person to happiness, Arjuna, and passion ties a person to action. But dullness covers knowledge and ties a person to carelessness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा
words: passion rises over goodness and dullness
and dullness over goodness and passion
verses.tr: Sometimes goodness rises, Arjuna, overpowering passion and dullness. Sometimes passion overpowers goodness and dullness, and sometimes dullness overpowers goodness and passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: in all the gates of this body
verses.tr: When the light of knowledge shines through all the gates of this body, know that goodness has grown strong.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: these arise when passion grows strong
verses.tr: Greed, constant activity, the starting of many projects, restlessness and longing: these arise, Arjuna, when passion grows strong.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: these arise when dullness grows strong
verses.tr: Darkness, inactivity, carelessness and delusion: these arise, Arjuna, when dullness grows strong.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्
words: and the embodied soul meets death
then the pure worlds of those who know the highest
verses.tr: If a person dies when goodness is strong, that soul reaches the pure worlds of those who know the highest.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: one is born among people attached to action
one is born among the unthinking
verses.tr: One who dies when passion is strong is born among people attached to action. One who dies in dullness is born among creatures without understanding.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: they say that of good action
the fruit is pure and of goodness
but the fruit of passion is pain
and the fruit of dullness is ignorance
verses.tr: They say that the fruit of good action is pure and belongs to goodness. The fruit of passion is pain, and the fruit of dullness is ignorance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च
words: from dullness come carelessness and delusion
verses.tr: From goodness comes knowledge, and from passion comes greed. From dullness come carelessness, delusion and ignorance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः
words: those settled in goodness go upward
those of passion stay in the middle
settled in the ways of the lowest guna
verses.tr: Those settled in goodness go upward. Those of passion stay in the middle. Those of dullness, settled in the ways of the lowest guna, go downward.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: no doer other than the gunas
when the one who sees perceives
and knows what is beyond the gunas
verses.tr: When the one who sees perceives that there is no doer other than the gunas, and knows what is beyond the gunas, that person reaches my state.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: freed from birth, death, old age and sorrow
verses.tr: When the soul goes beyond these three gunas, from which the body arises, it is freed from birth, death, old age and sorrow, and reaches immortality.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: is one known to have gone beyond these three gunas
how does such a person behave
कथं च एतान् त्रीन् गुणान् अतिवर्तते
and how does one go beyond these three gunas
verses.tr: Arjuna asked: Lord, what are the signs of a person who has gone beyond these three gunas? How does such a person behave, and how does one go beyond the three gunas?

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
words: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहम् एव च
one does not hate them when they are present
and does not long for them when they are gone
verses.tr: Krishna said: Such a person, Arjuna, does not hate light, activity or delusion when they are present, and does not long for them when they are gone.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: seated like one who is not involved
who is not shaken by the gunas
knowing “it is only the gunas that act”
who stands firm and does not waver
verses.tr: Such a person sits like one who is not involved and is not shaken by the gunas. Knowing that it is only the gunas that act, that person stands firm and does not waver.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the same in pain and pleasure
to whom a lump of earth, a stone and gold are the same
equal towards the pleasant and the unpleasant
to whom blame and praise of oneself are equal
verses.tr: The same in pain and pleasure, settled in the self; seeing a lump of earth, a stone and gold as the same; steady, and equal towards the pleasant and the unpleasant, towards blame and praise;

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the same in honour and insult
the same to the side of friend and of enemy
who has given up all selfish undertakings
that person is said to have gone beyond the gunas
verses.tr: the same in honour and insult, the same to friend and enemy, and having given up all selfish undertakings: such a person is said to have gone beyond the gunas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with the yoga of devotion that never strays
becomes fit to be one with Brahman
verses.tr: And whoever serves me with unfailing devotion goes beyond these gunas and becomes fit to be one with Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: for I am the foundation of Brahman
verses.tr: For I am the foundation of Brahman, the immortal and unchanging, and of eternal dharma and perfect happiness.
